policy: Keep the English original for proper nouns; translate everything else into Catalan.
style: Use natural Catalan punctuation (l'apòstrof, els guions llargs).
Keep ALL markup exactly: , , , , and the literal \n sequences.
Do not translate text inside <color=orange>...</color> item names unless they are common nouns.
Avoid the interpunct in 'l·l' until glyph coverage is verified; use 'l-l' or rephrase.
